summary: Updated get_recent_completed() to SELECT target_branch from task_commits and use it for push_target when non-NULL, falling back to fleet/ prefix detection (→ 'main') or branch name. Added 4 unit tests covering all 4 cases (explicit target_branch, target_branch='main', NULL+fleet/ fallback, NULL+non-fleet). Updated REQUIRED_COLUMNS set and mock fake_rows to include target_branch. Template unchanged (already uses rc.push_target). DB migration command provided but DB unreachable in this environment.
